questions.question: If tan A = 3/7, then what is the value of cosec A?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

tan A = 3/7

**Concept Used:**

Trigonometric identity: cosec² A = 1 + cot² A

**Calculation:**

⇒ cot A = 7/3 (since cot A = 1/tan A)

⇒ cosec² A = 1 + (7/3)²

⇒ cosec² A = 1 + 49/9

⇒ cosec² A = 58/9

⇒ cosec A = √(58/9) = √(58) / 3

**Hence, cosec A = √(58) / 3**

questions.question: A 1800 metres long train crosses a man walking in opposite direction in 10 seconds. If the speed of train is 8 times to the speed of man, then what is the speed of train?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Length of train = 1800 meters,

Time taken = 10 seconds,

Ratio of speeds = 8:1

**Concept Used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

**Calculation:**

Total speed = Distance / Time = 1800 m / 10 s = 180 m/s (This is the relative speed)

Speed of train = 8/9 × total speed = 8/9 × 180 = 160 m/s

In km/hr, 160 × 18/5 = 576 km/hr

**Therefore the speed of the train is 576 km/hr.**

questions.question: Distance of a chord RS from the centre is 20 cm. If the length of this chord is 30 cm, then what will be the diameter of this circle?
questions.solution:
Given:

Distance of a chord RS from the centre is 20 cm.

The length of this chord is 30 cm.

Formula used:

1. Radius² = (Distance of the chord from the center)² + (Half of the Chord length)²

2. Diameter = Radius × 2

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c2297e01dc0d45d118af8d45e2ed894cfdc372b2e37c2aa593eb24bbfcd4675.png] 

Half of the chord length = 30/2 = 15 cm

Distance of the chord from the center = 20 cm

According to the formula,

Length of the radius = sqrt{20² + 15²} = 25 cm

Now, the length of the diameter = 25 × 2 = 50 cm

∴ The diameter of the circle will be 50 cm.

Rs. 43,120 is divided among P, Q and R such that P's share is 4/7 of total share of Q and R together and Q's share is 2/5 of total share of P and R together. What is the share of R?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Total amount = Rs. 43,120,

P's share is 4/7 of total share of Q and R together.

Q's share is 2/5 of total share of P and R together.

**Concept Used:**

Ratio and proportion method for distribution

**Calculation:**

P/(Q + R) = 4/7 .............(i)

Q/(P + R) = 2/5 .............(ii)

Make the sum of numerator and denominator equal in both equation by multiply (i) by 7 and (ii) by 11.

P/(Q + R) = 28/49 

Q/(P + R) = 22/55

⇒ P : Q : R = 28 : 22 : 27

⇒ Total parts = 28 + 22 + 27 = 77

⇒ Share of R = (27/77) × Rs. 43,120 = Rs. 15120

**Therefore, R's share is Rs. 15120.**

questions.question: Three metallic cubes whose sides are 6 cm, 8 cm and 10 cm respectively are melted and converted into a single cube. If there is no loss of metal in this process, then what is the length of the side of the new cube?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Side lengths of cubes = 6 cm, 8 cm, 10 cm

**Concept Used:**

Volume of cube = side³, total volume remains same after melting

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total volume = 6³ + 8³ + 10³

⇒ Side of new cube = ∛total volume = ∛(216 + 512 + 1000) = ∛1728 = 12 cm

**Hence, the side length of the new cube is 12 cm.**

questions.question: The average of marks obtained by X and Y is 35 less than the average marks obtained by Y and Z. If the marks obtained by Z is 85, what is the marks obtained by X?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average(Y,Z) - Average(X,Y) = 35,

Z = 85

**Concept Used:** 

Average formula, X+Y = 2(Average of X,Y) and Y+Z = 2(Average of Y,Z)

**Calculation:**

Average(Y,Z) - Average(X,Y) = 35,

⇒ (Y + Z)/2 - (X + Y)/2 = 35

⇒ Y + Z - X - Y = 70

⇒ 85 - X = 70

⇒ X = 15

**Therefore, the marks obtained by X are 15.**

questions.question: P sells a bottle to Q at a profit of 30 percent and Q sells it to R at a profit of 20 percent. What is the ratio of cost prices of P and R?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Profit percentages = 30%, 20%

**Concept Used:**

Profit = Selling Price - Cost Price

**Calculation:**

⇒ CP of Q = 130% of CP of P

⇒ CP of R = 120% of CP of Q

⇒ 120% of 130% of CP of P = 156% of CP of P

⇒ Ratio of CPs of P and R = CP of P/CP of R

⇒ 1/1.56 = 100/156 = 25 : 39

**Hence, the ratio of the cost prices of P and R is 25 : 39.**

questions.question: A man borrows a sum of Rs. 12,000 which amounts to Rs. 13,200 in 2 years on simple interest. What would have been the amount if the rate of interest was doubled?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Simple Interest is directly proportional to the rate of interest when Principal and Time are constant.

Original Simple Interest = Rs. 13,200 − Rs. 12,000 = Rs. 1,200

If the rate of interest is doubled, the Simple Interest will also be doubled.

New Simple Interest = 2 × 1,200 = Rs. 2,400

New Amount = Principal + New Interest = 12,000 + 2,400 = Rs. 14,400

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 14,400.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 12,000

Amount in 2 years (A) = Rs. 13,200

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (I) = A − P

I = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da3a82cf7318b08ad6307d87c03469ea7a1bef468aa7f1c8d3155d0f1097ca39.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Original Interest = 13,200 − 12,000 = Rs. 1,200

⇒ 1,200 = (12,000 × R × 2) ÷ 100

⇒ 1,200 = 240 × R

⇒ R = 1,200 ÷ 240 = 5%

⇒ New Rate = 2 × 5% = 10%

⇒ New Interest = (12,000 × 10 × 2) ÷ 100 = Rs. 2,400

⇒ New Amount = 12,000 + 2,400 = Rs. 14,400

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 14,400.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Proportionality in Simple Interest

Simple interest is directly proportional to Principal (P), Rate (R), and Time (T). If any one of these is multiplied by a factor while the others remain constant, the Simple Interest is simply multiplied by the same factor.

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest

In Simple Interest, the interest is calculated only on the original principal every year, meaning it remains constant per period. In Compound Interest, interest is calculated on both the original principal and the accumulated interest from previous periods.

Simple Interest Formula

The formula to calculate simple interest is I = (P × R × T) ÷ 100. The total amount at the end of the time period is the sum of the principal and the interest earned: A = P + I.
</p

questions.question: What is the value of (tan theta - sec theta + 1)/(tan theta + sec theta - 1)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let θ = 45°

Expression = (tan 45° − sec 45° + 1) / (tan 45° + sec 45° − 1) = (1 − √2 + 1) / (1 + √2 − 1)

⇒ Expression = (2 − √2) / √2 = √2 − 1

Check Option 4: cos 45° / (1 + sin 45°) = (1/√2) / (1 + 1/√2) = 1 / (√2 + 1) = √2 − 1

**∴ The correct answer is cos θ / (1 + sin θ).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = (tan θ − sec θ + 1) / (tan θ + sec θ − 1)

**Formula Used:**

sec² θ − tan² θ = 1

**Calculations:**

⇒ Replace 1 in the numerator with (sec² θ − tan² θ)

⇒ Numerator = tan θ − sec θ + (sec² θ − tan² θ)

⇒ Numerator = −(sec θ − tan θ) + (sec θ − tan θ)(sec θ + tan θ)

⇒ Numerator = (sec θ − tan θ)(sec θ + tan θ − 1)

⇒ Expression = [(sec θ − tan θ)(sec θ + tan θ − 1)] / (tan θ + sec θ − 1)

⇒ Expression = sec θ − tan θ = (1 / cos θ) − (sin θ / cos θ)

⇒ Expression = (1 − sin θ) / cos θ

⇒ Multiply numerator and denominator by (1 + sin θ)

⇒ Expression = [(1 − sin θ)(1 + sin θ)] / [cos θ(1 + sin θ)]

⇒ Expression = (1 − sin² θ) / [cos θ(1 + sin θ)] = cos² θ / [cos θ(1 + sin θ)]

⇒ Expression = cos θ / (1 + sin θ)

**∴ The correct answer is cos θ / (1 + sin θ).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

The Pythagorean identities are sin² θ + cos² θ = 1, sec² θ − tan² θ = 1, and cosec² θ − cot² θ = 1.

Value Substitution Method

When simplifying trigonometric expressions, substituting standard angles (like 30°, 45°, or 60°) can quickly verify the correct option. Always ensure the substituted angle doesn't make any denominator zero.

Conjugate Properties

Multiplying and dividing by the conjugate (e.g., 1 + sin θ) helps rationalize terms, allowing seamless conversions like (1 − sin θ) / cos θ → cos θ / (1 + sin θ).
</p

Raman spends 50 percent of his income. If his income increases by 10 percent and the expenditure also increases by 10 percent, then what will be the percentage increase in his savings?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Raman spends 50 percent of his income.

His income increases by 10 percent and the expenditure also increases by 10 percent.

**Concept Used:**

Income = Saving + Expenditure

**Calculation:**

Let the income of Raman be Rs. 100

According to the problem statement

Amount to be spend by Raman can be given as

Amount spent = 100 × (50/100) = Rs. 50

Now the savings is 100 – 50 = Rs. 50

If income increased by 10%, new income will be

New income = 100 × (1 + 10/100) = Rs. 110

Expenditure increased by 10% can be given as

⇒ final expenditure = 50 × (1 + 10/100) = 50 × 1.1 = Rs. 55

Savings can be given as 110 – 55 = 55

Increase in saving is 55 – 50 = Rs. 5

⇒ percentage increase in savings can be given as = 5 × 100/50 = 10%

**∴ The increase in savings is 10%**

questions.question: A alone can complete the project in 10 days; B alone can complete it in 20 days while C alone can complete it in 30 days. They together earn Rs. 1,100 for the project. By how much do the total earnings of A and C exceed the earnings of B?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Wage ratio = Inverse ratio of days taken = 1/10 : 1/20 : 1/30 = 6 : 3 : 2

Total ratio parts = 6 + 3 + 2 = 11 parts → Rs. 1100

1 part → Rs. 100

Required difference = (A + C) − B = (6 + 2) − 3 = 5 parts

Difference = 5 × 100 = Rs. 500

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A alone = 10 days

Time taken by B alone = 20 days

Time taken by C alone = 30 days

Total earnings = Rs. 1100

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**

 6

 20

**Calculations:**

⇒ Ratio of efficiencies A : B : C = 6 : 3 : 2

⇒ Total efficiency parts = 6 + 3 + 2 = 11 parts

⇒ Earnings of A = (6 ÷ 11) × 1100 = Rs. 600

⇒ Earnings of B = (3 ÷ 11) × 1100 = Rs. 300

⇒ Earnings of C = (2 ÷ 11) × 1100 = Rs. 200

⇒ Total earnings of A and C = 600 + 200 = Rs. 800

⇒ Required difference = Total earnings of (A + C) − Earnings of B

⇒ Required difference = 800 − 300 = Rs. 500

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Wages

Wages are always distributed in proportion to the total work done by each individual. If individuals work together for the same number of days, their wages are divided exactly in the ratio of their one-day work (efficiencies).

Efficiency and Time Relation

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken to complete the work. For instance, if the ratio of time taken by two people is A : B, their efficiency ratio is B : A.

Total Work Assumption

A highly effective way to determine total work is by calculating the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of the distinct days taken by all individuals to finish the task alone.
</p

questions.question: Which of the following is largest among (125)^(1)/(6), (11)^(1)/(3), (12)^(1)/(6), (5)^(1)/(4) ?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

LCM of denominators of powers (6, 3, 6, 4) is 12.

Raise all values to the 12th power:

((125)¹/⁶)¹² = 125² = 15625

((11)¹/³)¹² = 11⁴ = 14641

((12)¹/⁶)¹² = 12² = 144; ((5)¹/⁴)¹² = 5³ = 125

Comparing results: 15625 > 14641 > 144 > 125.

**∴ The correct answer is (125)¹/⁶.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (125)¹/⁶, (11)¹/³, (12)¹/⁶, (5)¹/⁴

**Formula:** To compare a¹/ⁿ and b¹/m, convert them to a common index by finding the LCM of denominators.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71aad04defbc2e72676231319f02ac3f5b8e8d7a39beebd013a19c1fbbe61805.png] 

⇒ Convert all powers to a common denominator 12:

⇒ (125)¹/⁶ = (125)²/¹² = (125²)¹/¹² = (15625)¹/¹²

⇒ (11)¹/³ = (11)⁴/¹² = (11⁴)¹/¹² = (14641)¹/¹²

⇒ (12)¹/⁶ = (12)²/¹² = (12²)¹/¹² = (144)¹/¹²

⇒ (5)¹/⁴ = (5)³/¹² = (5³)¹/¹² = (125)¹/¹²

⇒ Since 15625 > 14641 > 144 > 125, the largest value is (15625)¹/¹².

**∴ The correct answer is (125)¹/⁶.**

**__Additional Information__**

Comparing Surds of Different Indices

To compare numbers like ⁿ√a and m√b, find the LCM of n and m. Raise both numbers to the power of the LCM to eliminate the radical signs.

Laws of Indices

Important properties include (am)ⁿ = am×ⁿ and a¹/ⁿ = ⁿ√a. These are essential for simplifying expressions before comparison.

Ascending and Descending Order

Once terms are converted to the same index (e.g., x¹/¹²), they can be sorted based on the magnitude of the base x.</p

questions.question: If a + (1)/(a) = 4, then what is the value of a⁴ + (1)/(a⁴)?

a + 1/a = 4

**Formula used:**

If a + 1/a = k, then

a² + 1/a² = k² - 2

a4 + 1/a4 = (k2 - 2)² - 2

**Calculation:**

⇒ a4 + 1/a4 = (42 - 2)2 - 2

⇒ a4 + 1/a4 = (16 - 2)2 - 2

⇒ a4 + 1/a4 = (14)2 - 2 = 194

**Hence, the value of a⁴ + 1/a⁴ is 194.**
